meta.title: Delete account
meta.description: Permanently delete your user account on Misbah EDU (website and mobile app).

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.whatIsDeleted: Here you can permanently delete your Misbah EDU account — the same account is used on the website and in the mobile app. Deleting it permanently removes your username, password, all of your comments and likes. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.inApp: In the mobile app, you can also delete your account in the menu Više → Obriši nalog (More → Delete account). Data stored only on your phone (saved content, settings) is deleted by uninstalling the app.
deleteAccount.cannotLogIn: Can't log in? Write to us at <mail>{email}</mail> with your username and we will delete the account within 7 days. More about data in the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

form.confirm: I understand that the account, comments and likes will be permanently deleted.
form.done: Your account and all related data have been permanently deleted.

errors.notConfirmed: Please confirm that you want to permanently delete the account.
